entities.summary: Gerry Leonard is an Irish guitarist known for his harmonic and ambient guitar style, and for his work with David Bowie, Suzanne Vega, Rufus Wainwright, Laurie Anderson, Duncan Sheik and many others. He has a solo project called Spooky Ghost. He lives in New York.
